## What to change

Which file, and what is wrong or missing? For copy, say whether it is English, Kannada, or both.

## How to tell it is done

- [ ] The change is limited to docs, strings, or a test of behaviour that already exists
- [ ] `pytest -q` and/or `npm test` still pass if code or tests changed
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, or new product behaviour

## Notes

See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for setup. The live demo (https://croppilot-rabi.vercel.app) is a separate deployment.
